keep-ansi at all four colour levels: C brackets the name, hit/mana/move current (green) and maximum (red), experience, carried and banked gold, and the exp-to-level figure with CCxxx(ch, C_CMP)/CCNRM. The port emitted no colour at all, so every escape was missing at complete and the whole command read plain. R1/R5e/R5h.

keep-ansi at all four colour levels: the short list uses CCYEL(ch, C_SPR), while the long list writes literal &r/&y codes closed by "&n" (src/act.informative.c:1841,1870,1923) which color_expansion resolves per recipient. The port emitted a conditional ANSI escape instead, so a colour-off viewer saw the line plain where C shows the raw &r[ Wizard ] ...&n codes; the codes are now emitted verbatim. R1/R5e/R5h.
Reading or looking at a note with no action_description prints "It's blank.".

do_skills is declared (src/interpreter.c:237) but has no command-table entry; "skills" resolves by prefix to "skillset" (src/interpreter.c:704), so the usage and invalid-class arms are unreachable. A grep of src/ for do_skills( finds no caller outside the ACMD definition, so the whole body is dead, not just the two arms.
